description: tanilo.anchor.v1 Merkle inclusion vectors. Leaves are sha256("receipt-" + i). Every entry in "valid" must recompute to proof.root; no entry in "invalid" may.

invalid.name: wrong-receipt
invalid.why: the proof's leaf is another receipt's hash

invalid.name: wrong-root
invalid.why: the stated root is not the recomputed one

invalid.name: wrong-index
invalid.why: the leaf index is off by one

invalid.name: wrong-tree-size
invalid.why: a tree size that changes the path shape

invalid.name: path-element-changed
invalid.why: one byte of a path element differs

invalid.name: path-uppercase
invalid.why: path elements must be lower-case hex

invalid.name: leaf-without-domain-prefix
invalid.why: root computed without the 0x00 leaf prefix does not match
